name: Compute Cluster S73: Momentum & Oscillators
description: Tests: mom, rocr, cmo, apo, ppo, mfi, willr, stoch, stochrsi, ao, bop, fisher, trix, dpo, fosc, ultosc, vhf, msw, cci, psl. Comprehensive momentum/oscillator coverage.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S73: Momentum & Oscillators
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
open_p = src.o
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c
volume = src.v

# === BASIC MOMENTUM ===
mom_val = mom(period=10)(close)
rocr_val = rocr(period=10)(close)

# === CHANNEL MOMENTUM OSCILLATOR ===
cmo_val = cmo(period=14)(close)

# === ABSOLUTE / PERCENTAGE PRICE OSCILLATOR ===
apo_val = apo(short_period=12, long_period=26)(close)
ppo_val = ppo(short_period=12, long_period=26)(close)

# === MONEY FLOW INDEX (needs HLCV) ===
mfi_val = mfi(period=14)(high, low, close, volume)

# === WILLIAMS %R ===
willr_val = willr(period=14)(high, low, close)

# === STOCHASTIC ===
stoch_val = stoch(k_period=14, k_slowing_period=3, d_period=3)(high, low, close)
stoch_k = stoch_val.stoch_k
stoch_d = stoch_val.stoch_d

# === STOCHASTIC RSI ===
stochrsi_val = stochrsi(period=14)(close)

# === AWESOME OSCILLATOR (no params) ===
ao_val = ao()(high, low)

# === BALANCE OF POWER ===
bop_val = bop()(open_p, high, low, close)

# === FISHER TRANSFORM ===
fisher_val = fisher(period=9)(high, low)
fisher_line = fisher_val.fisher
fisher_signal = fisher_val.fisher_signal

# === TRIX (triple EMA rate of change) ===
trix_val = trix(period=15)(close)

# === DETRENDED PRICE OSCILLATOR ===
dpo_val = dpo(period=20)(close)

# === FORECAST OSCILLATOR ===
fosc_val = fosc(period=14)(close)

# === ULTIMATE OSCILLATOR ===
ultosc_val = ultosc(short_period=7, medium_period=14, long_period=28)(high, low, close)

# === VERTICAL HORIZONTAL FILTER ===
vhf_val = vhf(period=28)(close)

# === MESA SINE WAVE ===
msw_val = msw(period=25)(close)
msw_sine = msw_val.msw_sine
msw_lead = msw_val.msw_lead

# === CCI ===
cci_val = cci(period=20)(high, low, close)

# === PSL (Psychological Line) ===
psl_val = psl(period=12)(open_p, close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Momentum & ROCR (10d)',
    category='Momentum',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Momentum', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ROCR', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(mom_val, rocr_val))

xy_lines(
    title='CMO / APO / PPO',
    category='Oscillators',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CMO(14)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='APO(12,26)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='PPO(12,26)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cmo_val, apo_val, ppo_val))

xy_lines(
    title='Stoch %K/%D & Williams %R',
    category='Oscillators',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Stoch %K', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Stoch %D', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Williams %R', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(stoch_k, stoch_d, willr_val))

xy_lines(
    title='MFI / StochRSI / UltOsc',
    category='Oscillators',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MFI(14)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='StochRSI(14)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='UltOsc', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(mfi_val, stochrsi_val, ultosc_val))

xy_lines(
    title='Fisher / TRIX / DPO / FOSC',
    category='Momentum',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fisher', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TRIX(15)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DPO(20)', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='FOSC(14)', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(fisher_line, trix_val, dpo_val, fosc_val))

xy_lines(
    title='CCI / VHF / PSL',
    category='Momentum',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CCI(20)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VHF(28)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='PSL(12)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cci_val, vhf_val, psl_val))
